title: Sprint tooling 1: config layer, external ids, brief and dispatch, rules in the brief, cost without capture
goal: backlog.py reads a backlog.json at the repository root with the kb's values as the default and prints the effective config; an item carries typed external tracker ids that backlog.json validates and commits and merge requests carry; backlog.py brief ID prints the worker's brief and dispatch ID starts the headless worker from it on stdin with its scratch directory and turn cap; a brief carries the rules of the project's docs map or of its kb root; and backlog.py cost says no capture instead of printing zeros
